title: HejjéTrac: native spherical-motion tracking
description:
A native Rust reworking of FicTrac for tracking patterned spherical treadmills and reconstructing fictive animal paths. Includes a desktop application, guided calibration, independent rig sessions, recording, live outputs, a command-line interface and local agent protocols.

Created by Pavan Kumar Kaushik. Inspired by FicTrac, developed by R. J. D. Moore, Saul Thurrowgood and collaborators. This project preserves upstream CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 terms. Research users should also cite Moore et al. (2014), DOI: 10.1016/j.jneumeth.2014.01.010.
